in_sanskrit.name: गोपी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Gopi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'go-p' which means 'cow' and 'p' which means 'protector'. It can also be interpreted as a friend of cows. This name is often used in Hindu mythology to refer to the cowherd men who were friends of Lord Krishna.

in_hindi.name: गोपी
in_hindi.long_meaning: हिंदी में 'गोपी' के नाम का स्थानिक नाम है 'गोपाल' है। यह केवला गोपाल का एक नाम है जो गाओं के प्रेमिक और संरक्षक है।

in_tamil.name: கோபி
in_tamil.long_meaning: தமிழ் மேலும் 'கோபி' அவர்கள் கோவில் அரசர்கள் அல்லவால் கோவில் அவர்களின் ஜனநாயகர்கள் இருக்கும் இழித்துக்கெடுக்கப்பட்ட ஒன்று இந்த எழுத்துக்களின் நாமம் இருக்கும்।

in_telugu.name: గోపి
in_telugu.long_meaning: తెలుగు మేళ్లేదు 'గోపి' అవరోజు గోపాల ప్రేమియేదు, గోపాల అభేద్యముయేదు ఇద్దరోజు ఇద్దేయేదు ఎప్పుడౌయ్యేదు.

in_marathi.name: Gopi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gopi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from Sanskrit 'go' meaning 'cow' and 'pī' meaning 'feeder' or 'milkmaid'. In Hindu mythology, a gopi is a milkmaid who tends to the cows and is devoted to Lord Krishna.

in_bengali.name: Gopi
in_bengali.long_meaning: Gopi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name derived from Sanskrit 'go' meaning 'cow' and 'pī' meaning 'feeder' or 'milkmaid'. In Hindu mythology, a gopi is a milkmaid who tends to the cows and is devoted to Lord Krishna.
